{{Otheruses|Amphitheater}}
The '''Amphitheater''' was a room within the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] in which the [[Council of Elders (Alderaan)|Council of Elders]] held its official meetings. It had tiers of benches surrounding a central open area where the speaker stood, and a concealed opening leading to a command chamber. The Amphitheater was adjacent to the Elders' Lounge, which contained couches and a [[Holochess/Legends|holochess]] table, where councillors could relax during official sessions. Both the Amphitheater and its lounge were contained inside the portion of the Palace that survived the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GoA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref>
